svg.title: Three different publication checks
svg.desc: Editorial questions, not a legal certificate or permission. Genuine experience: retain the source, relevant service and original meaning. Basis and scope of use: check rights, authority, attribution, channels, media, privacy and applicable platform conditions. Claims and context: check evidence, qualifiers, selection and the overall impression on the finished page. A recorded approval does not establish every advertising claim. Decisions can include final checks, revising, seeking evidence, clarifying rights or not publishing. These questions do not grant rights or certify compliance. No real customer material or outcome is represented.

g.text: EDITORIAL QUESTIONS · NO REAL CUSTOMER MATERIAL
One recorded approval does not answer every question.
Keep the source, relevant service and original wording.
Does the excerpt preserve what the person meant?
Check rights, authority, attribution and intended channels.
Consider media, privacy and applicable platform conditions.
Check supporting evidence, qualifiers and the selection shown.
Read the quote with its heading and surrounding message.
Proceed to final checks, revise, seek evidence,
clarify rights, or leave the material unpublished.
Check the finished page, including qualifiers and disclosures.
These questions do not grant rights or certify compliance.
